title: Measured reliability
description: What the network measured over the last 30 days of admitted customer calls to a service through the adapter profile. Trials, validation, probe and retest calls are never included. Present only from 20 calls.

calls.description: Admitted customer calls in the window.

success_rate.description: Succeeded ÷ calls with a known outcome.

p50_ms.description: Median latency from admission to completion, ms.

schema_violation_rate.description: Share of calls whose output the provider or the consumer reported invalid against the output schema.

unknown_rate.description: Share of calls whose outcome stayed unknown.

declared_p95_ms.description: The provider's declared response_p95_ms, if any.

above_declared.description: p95_ms is more than 1.5 times the declared value.
